    total = df['prim_threatened_aggregate'].sum()
    df['cumulative'] = df['prim_threatened_aggregate'].cumsum()
    df['cumulative_pct'] = df['cumulative'] / total
    
    # Find the number of fires needed to reach 90% of total houses damaged
    fires_for_90pct = (df['cumulative_pct'] < 0.90).sum() + 1
    total_fires = len(df)

        'proportion': [round(proportion, 4)],
        'total_prim_threatened': [total],
        'cumulative_pct_at_threshold': [df.loc[fires_for_90pct - 1, 'cumulative_pct']]
    })
